name: test-cycle
description: From failing behavior to trusted green: diagnose an unclear cause, lock the fix test-first, hunt the defect's twins, drive a broken change back to green, and build or audit the test net before a refactor

interface.shortDescription: Tests as the proof instrument, from an unclear failure to a green suite you can trust
interface.longDescription: Six skills for one chain. diagnose finds a cause whose location is unclear, intermittent, or spread across components, and stops at cause-known. tdd locks the fix or the new behavior in test-first, red-green-refactor. bug-epidemiology hunts the confirmed defect's twins across the codebase before closeout. keep-green drives a change that broke lint or tests back to green with bounded attempts and oscillation detection. Before a refactor of untested code, characterization-tests pins what the code does now and proves the net with a deliberate mutation, and test-trust-audit says whether a green suite can be trusted at all.
defaultPrompt: The cause is confirmed; hunt its twins
Tests broke after my change; get them back to green
Pin this untested module before I refactor it
Can this green suite be trusted?
